ask: Is it right to leave release-branch runs out of the flaky-test count?
problem: A web test named PASS-004 failed in 2 of 27 checks, so the nightly check filed an issue calling it flaky.
found: The test plays a translator opening a passage a reviewer sent back. It expects the note, a Hear the feedback button, and a Record a fix page. It failed only on old release code, which read the screen too early.
changed: No change for people. The nightly check no longer counts release-branch runs. I removed the set-aside tag from the test, so it keeps blocking.
why: Main fixed the early read on 29 October, but the release branch is older. Ten local runs under heavy load all passed. Setting the test aside would hide a working test.
touches: Only the nightly flaky-test report. The release branch gets the fix when it next catches up with main.
